questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated
questions.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.13026/37yb-1t42; title: 'Bridge2AI-Voice - An ethically-sourced, diverse voice dataset linked to health information'; description: ~1400-char narrative; keywords: 50+ terms; license_and_use_terms: detailed 'Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License' block
questions.quality_note: All five mandatory fields present with substantive, high-quality content (100% populated).

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.evidence: description field spans lines 4-20 (~1400 chars) covering purpose, biomarker rationale, cohorts, version stats, and access model; motivation captured via four detailed 'purposes' entries (lines 80-106)
questions.quality_note: Narrative fields far exceed the 200-char threshold with rich, informative content.

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.evidence: keywords list (lines 27-77) contains 50+ unique terms including 'voice biomarker', 'MFCC', 'OpenSMILE', 'BIDS', 'FAIR principles', 'CARE principles', 'PhysioNet', plus disease-specific terms (Parkinson's disease, ALS, laryngeal cancer, COPD)
questions.quality_note: Keyword coverage vastly exceeds 8, spanning modalities, tools, standards, and clinical conditions for strong discoverability.

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of files and file type diversity
questions.evidence: distribution_formats (lines 683-705) enumerate Parquet, TSV, JSON, WAV; distributions add GZ archive (line 741). Formats: Parquet, TSV, JSON, WAV, GZ = 5 distinct types
questions.quality_note: More than three distinct file types documented, reflecting multi-modal derived features, phenotype tables, dictionaries, and raw audio.

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or dimensional metadata
questions.evidence: Dimensional metadata present: spectrograms '513xN dimensions' (line 521), MFCC 'Output dimension 60xN' (line 527), counts of 833 adult participants and ~61,937 voice-derived recordings (lines 15-16, 221), 300 pediatric participants
questions.quality_note: Explicit array dimensions and record/participant counts satisfy the dimensional-metadata requirement.

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.description: Presence of unique persistent identifiers
questions.evidence: doi: 10.13026/37yb-1t42 (line 21); id is the DOI URL (line 1); page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org (line 22); version-specific DOIs referenced in version_access (lines 801-805)
questions.quality_note: Persistent DOI plus documentation URL and version-specific DOIs are all present.

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, sponsors
questions.evidence: funders (lines 196-209): 'NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program. Grant number: 3OT2OD032720-01S3. Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008... Total funding in 2025: $4,660,942'; second funder 'NIBIB... NIH grant number R01EB030362' supporting PhysioNet
questions.quality_note: Agency, award numbers, funding amounts, project dates, and administering institute all documented for two funders.

questions.name: Ethical and Privacy Declarations
questions.description: Deidentification methods, IRB approvals, ethical sourcing
questions.score_label: IRB approval + deidentification + ethical sourcing details
questions.evidence: ethical_reviews: 'IRB review and approval obtained from University of South Florida Single IRB' (lines 820-827); is_deidentified: 'HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification applied... Direct identifiers removed: Yes' (lines 898-908); Certificate of Confidentiality (lines 297-301); informed_consent (lines 843-853)
questions.quality_note: IRB approval, HIPAA Safe Harbor deidentification detail, informed consent, and ethical-sourcing framing are comprehensively documented.

questions.name: Access Requirements Documentation
questions.description: Access policy and license clarity
questions.score_label: License + Data Use Agreement + platform access description
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'distributed through PhysioNet under Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access License. Only registered users who sign the specified Data Use Agreement... can access files. Raw audio available through controlled access only via Data Access Compliance Office (DACO)... DTUA signed by institutional official' (lines 865-877)
questions.quality_note: License type, signed DUA requirement, tiered registered/controlled access, and distributing platforms all clearly defined.

questions.name: Interoperability and Standardization
questions.description: Standard formats, ontologies, schema conformance
questions.evidence: Standard formats Parquet/TSV/JSON throughout; 'BIDS v1.9.0 compliant structure' (lines 483, 696, 719); ICD-10 codes for diagnostic labels (line 227); FAIR and CARE principles referenced in keywords and purposes
questions.quality_note: Standard formats combined with explicit BIDS v1.9.0 schema conformance and ICD-10 coding satisfy full interoperability.

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.description: Preprocessing libraries or tools used
questions.score_label: Comprehensive list with versions or URLs
questions.evidence: preprocessing_strategies name b2aiprep, OpenSMILE eGeMaps, Parselmouth/Praat, torchaudio, SPARC, OpenAI Whisper (lines 511-558); external_resources give GitHub URLs for b2aiprep (https://github.com/sensein/b2aiprep) and REDCap dictionary; BIDS v1.9.0 version specified
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive tool inventory with repository URLs and standard/version references; minor gap is absence of individual library version pins, but coverage is otherwise excellent.

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.description: Participant recruitment and data acquisition detail
questions.score_label: Full recruitment and procedural details included
questions.evidence: sampling_strategies: 'Non-probability purposive sampling from specialty clinics... screened for eligibility per inclusion/exclusion criteria outlined in protocol Table 1' (lines 454-463); collection_mechanisms specify Bridge2AI-Voice App on iPad with Avid AE-36 microphone (lines 385-405); data_collectors describe site teams and compensation ($40/$80 gift cards) (lines 445-453)
questions.quality_note: Recruitment sampling, eligibility, hardware, acquisition tasks, and compensation are all thoroughly documented.

questions.name: Version History Documentation
questions.description: Multiple version records and dates
questions.score_label: ≥2 versions with change summaries and release dates
questions.evidence: updates and distribution_dates: 'v1.0 released January 17, 2025 (306 participants, 12,523 recordings); v1.1 added MFCC features; v2.0.0 April 16, 2025; v2.0.1 August 18, 2025; v3.0.0 released 2025 (833 adults, ~61,937 recordings)' (lines 706-713, 773-785)
questions.quality_note: Five versions with explicit release dates and change summaries; well beyond the threshold.

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.description: Formal citations or DOI-linked references
questions.score_label: Multiple references and dataset DOI cross-links
questions.evidence: external_resources include Interspeech 2024 protocol publication (https://doi.org/10.21437/Interspeech.2024-1926), Zenodo archive (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13834653), and NIH RePORTER project details (lines 939-963); dataset DOI cross-linked in id/doi/version_access
questions.quality_note: Multiple DOI-linked publications and archives plus the dataset DOI provide strong bidirectional citation.

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.description: Human subjects, demographic diversity, subgroup details
questions.evidence: subpopulations (lines 303-352) define six cohorts (Voice, Neurological aged 44-85, Mood/Psychiatric, Respiratory, Pediatric aged 2-18, Controls) with diagnostic detail and validation; at_risk_populations details pediatric protections; sampling_strategies specify English-speaking adults 18-120 with exclusion criteria
questions.quality_note: Rich cohort demographics, age ranges, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and vulnerable-population handling fully characterized.

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.evidence: page: https://docs.b2ai-voice.org; download_url: https://physionet.org/content/b2ai-voice/; DOI https://doi.org/10.13026/37yb-1t42; external_resources lists 12 persistent URLs (lines 910-978)
questions.quality_note: Numerous persistent, resolvable URLs and DOIs are present.

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.description: How users obtain the dataset
questions.score_label: Fully defined access path (platform, login, policy)
questions.evidence: distributions and license_and_use_terms describe registered access via PhysioNet requiring signed Bridge2AI Voice Registered Access Agreement, and controlled raw-audio access via DACO with institutional DTUA (contact DACO@b2ai-voice.org) (lines 714-752, 865-877)
questions.quality_note: Access path fully specified across platform, registration, DUA/DTUA policy, and contact points for both access tiers.

questions.name: Reusability (License Clarity)
questions.description: License clearly defines reuse terms
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'Commercial and non-commercial research use permitted for Authorized Researchers'; prohibited_uses forbids resale and re-identification (lines 660-667); ip_restrictions invoke Fort Lauderdale Agreement and Open Science (lines 878-887); discouraged_uses enumerated
questions.quality_note: Reuse permissions, prohibitions, and IP terms are explicit and unambiguous.

questions.name: Data Integrity and Provenance
questions.description: Change logs or provenance tracking
questions.evidence: version_access: 'All dataset versions available through PhysioNet... with version-specific DOIs' (lines 798-807); updates provide dated release log; retention_limit documents DTUA two-year term and destruction/certification requirements (lines 786-797)
questions.quality_note: Structured, timestamped version control with per-version DOIs and retention/provenance policy.

questions.name: Interlinking Across Platforms
questions.description: Metadata connects records across platforms
questions.evidence: external_resources cross-link PhysioNet, Health Data Nexus (https://healthdatanexus.ai/content/b2ai-voice/1.0/), GitHub repos (bridge2ai-docs, b2aiprep, bridge2ai-redcap), Zenodo, and NIH RePORTER (lines 910-978)
questions.quality_note: Verified cross-platform linkages across distribution, code, archival, and grant systems.

strengths: Complete structural metadata: all mandatory fields populated with extensive, high-quality narrative content and 50+ discoverability keywords
Exemplary ethical and privacy documentation including USF Single IRB approval, HIPAA Safe Harbor deidentification detail, informed consent, and a Certificate of Confidentiality
Thorough funding disclosure with agency, award numbers (3OT2OD032720-01S3, R01EB030362), amounts, and project dates
Comprehensive technical documentation: named preprocessing tools with repository URLs, BIDS v1.9.0 conformance, dimensional feature metadata (513xN, 60xN), and full collection protocol
Strong FAIR compliance with persistent DOIs, tiered access mechanisms (registered + DACO-controlled), version-specific DOIs, and dense cross-platform interlinking
weaknesses: Software tools are listed with repositories but individual library version pins (e.g., OpenSMILE, Whisper model size) are only partially specified
No formal re-identification risk analysis has been conducted beyond HIPAA Safe Harbor (acknowledged as a limitation)
Some derived-feature file-size figures are given as array dimensions/counts rather than absolute byte sizes
recommendations: Pin explicit version numbers for preprocessing libraries (b2aiprep, OpenSMILE, Whisper model variant, torchaudio) to improve reproducibility
Add absolute on-disk file/archive sizes alongside the existing dimensional metadata
Document any planned formal re-identification risk assessment for the de-identified public release
